title: Return of the Refundable Equipment Deposit at Cafe Contract Closure (Workplace Cafe Management Program)
content:
Where two or more contractual charges stand raised on the contract in the three months up to the day the settlement is worked out and a day of written notice of termination stands on the contract, the equipment deposit returned is the retained deposit share of the refundable equipment deposit printed against the service model, rounded to the nearest cent. Where exactly one contractual charge stands raised over those three months and a day of written notice of termination stands on the contract, the equipment deposit returned is the part retained deposit share of that deposit, rounded to the nearest cent. Otherwise the equipment deposit returned is the whole refundable equipment deposit printed against the service model, rounded to the nearest cent; where no contractual charge stands raised over those three months, that last case governs.

### The shares themselves

The retained deposit share is 40 per cent. The part retained deposit share is 70 per cent. Each share is taken on the refundable equipment deposit printed against the service model the Workplace Cafe Management Program contract is held in, and the figure that results is rounded to the nearest cent.

| Contractual charges standing raised in the three months up to the day the settlement is worked out | Day of written notice of termination on the contract | Equipment deposit returned |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | standing | 40 per cent of the refundable equipment deposit printed against the service model, rounded to the nearest cent |
| exactly 1 | standing | 70 per cent of that deposit, rounded to the nearest cent |
| any other case | not material | the whole refundable equipment deposit printed against the service model, rounded to the nearest cent |

### Reading the count and the notice

Both limbs of each of the first two cases are read together. Where three contractual charges stand raised over those three months but no day of written notice of termination stands on the contract, neither of those cases is met and the whole refundable equipment deposit printed against the service model is returned, rounded to the nearest cent.

### Illustration on hypothetical figures

On a hypothetical refundable equipment deposit of 8250.00 USD printed against the service model, the retained deposit share returns 3300.00 USD and the part retained deposit share returns 5775.00 USD, each rounded to the nearest cent. Those amounts are hypothetical.
